newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil rates seen stable next week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil rates seen stable next week.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil rates are likely to stay steady next week on fresh supplies, provided international prices remain stable, dealers said on Saturday.

"Vegoil prices will be steady next week as there are adequate supplies from foreign and domestic sources," dealer Mohammad Kamran said. "But local prices could rise in the weeks ahead if vegoil rates gain in the international market."
Dealers said stocks matched demand and the expected arrival of 28,000 tonnes of vegoil next week should keep prices stable.
"There is also a good supply of sunflower seed from domestic sources and the imports are likely to drop in the next few months," Kamran said.
Two ships with around 28,000 tonnes of vegoil are due in the next couple of days, while 182,000 tonnes of unsold stocks are available in the market, dealers said.
They put total vegoil stocks at around 182,000 tonnes, almost unchanged from the previous week.
